summary.headline: Astrological Treatises and Questions
summary.text: Catalog entries 333–353 for a Venetian astrological codex, covering times of life, business days, signs and configurations, lunar transits, actions, finding names, inquiries, runaway slaves, journeys, decan monomoiria, earthquakes, conjunctions, separations, agriculture, wells, gold, absences, delays, contests, and interrogations. Cross-references cite Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, Hephaestion, a Florentine codex, and Wachsmuth’s edition of Lydus.
